components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a region: solid Peso Green pill that glows on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Add expense</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 22px var(--glow); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: bordered Surface Raised pill; border turns green on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Final destructive confirmation, enabled only after the typed confirmation matches.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--danger); background: var(--danger); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Money Field
components.description: Labeled peso input: uppercase mono label, ₱ prefix, tabular mono value, green focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 220px; } .ds-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); } .ds-money { position: relative; } .ds-money span { position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); } .ds-money input { width: 100%; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 11px 9px 28px; color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-money input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }

components.name: Month Chips
components.description: Mono pills for months with trackers; the current month is green.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); color: var(--fg); } .ds-chip[aria-current="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Derived expense status: dot plus text label, never color alone.
components.html: SettledPartly paidOver budgetUpcoming
components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-settled { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-partial { color: var(--warn); background: var(--warn-soft); } .ds-over { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); } .ds-upcoming { color: var(--muted); border-color: var(--line-strong); }

components.name: View Toggle
components.description: Segmented Table / List switch; the pressed segment is solid green.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: KPI Tile
components.description: Flat Surface tile: mono eyebrow, large mono value, gradient budget meter.
components.html: Remaining₱4,820.0062% of budget spent
components.css: .ds-kpi { width: 260px; padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); } .ds-kpi b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--accent); } .ds-meter { display: block; height: 6px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter i { display: block; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); border-radius: 99px; } .ds-foot { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

narrative.overview:
Budget Mate is a calm control room for a household's month. The room is dark and quiet: Vault Black under a faint 32px graph-paper grid, with one or two soft green radial glows at the top edge of the page. Panels are lit readouts on that field. They separate by tone and thin lines, carry their numbers in tabular monospace, and sit still until something needs attention. Peso Green is the live signal. It marks the primary action, the selected state, the focus ring, and money that is still on plan, and almost nothing else.

Controls are tactile and confident. Buttons are full pills with a visible 1px border, so they read as pressable even at rest; the primary button is a solid green slab that glows on hover. Data stays precise: mono numerals, right-aligned amounts, uppercase mono labels with wide tracking. Density is that of a working tool: a full month of expenses, a chart, and three KPIs fit on one desktop screen without feeling crowded.

The system is dark-first and flips to a light theme with the same structure: a pale mint field, white panels, and a deeper green accent. The light theme is a full theme, not an inversion afterthought. It must hold the same hierarchy and contrast.

This is not a generic bank app (no corporate navy, no stock-photo trust signals) and not a crypto or trading screen (no glow on everything, no flashing tickers, no casino energy).
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first green-black field with a faint 32px grid and soft top-edge glow.
One accent, Peso Green, reserved for action, selection, focus, and on-plan money.
Tabular monospace for every amount, code, and eyebrow label.
Depth from tone and 1px lines at rest; shadows only for things that float.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Peso Green means "act here", "this is selected", or "on plan". If a green element is none of those, it should be a neutral.

rules.name: The Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status pill carries a dot and a text label. Red or amber is never the only way a state is shown.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: UI colors come from the CSS variables on `:root` (or the Tailwind names mapped to them). A new hex in a component is a bug unless it belongs to the category palette or logo gradient.

rules.name: The Mono Money Rule
rules.body: Every peso amount, household code, count, and percentage is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals, so columns line up and numbers read as data.

rules.name: The Real Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are uppercase mono, except a label that quotes text the user must type exactly (a category or household name to confirm a delete). That label keeps the real case in body type.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: A panel that lives in the page flow never gets a drop shadow. If it needs separation, step its tone or strengthen its line.

rules.name: The Green Light Rule
rules.body: Only Peso Green glows. Neutral, danger, and warn elements never get a glow.

dos: Do use CSS variables (`var(--accent)`, `bg-surface`, `text-muted`, `border-line`) for every UI color, and check both themes.
Do set every amount, code, and percentage in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals, right-aligned in columns.
Do keep Peso Green rare: primary action, selection, focus, and on-plan money.
Do give every status a dot and a text label in a pill.
Do separate in-flow panels with tone and 1px lines; save shadows for dialogs, menus, toasts, and showcase cards.
Do keep touch targets at least 40px, inputs at 16px text on phones, and dialogs as bottom sheets below 640px.
Do keep the visible 2px Peso Green focus outline on every interactive element.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`. Every animation and transition turns off.
donts: Don't drift toward a generic bank app: no corporate navy, no stock-photo trust imagery, no "secure banking" badges.
Don't drift toward crypto or trading screens: no glow on neutral surfaces, no flashing or ticking numbers, no neon on every element.
Don't introduce a second accent. Lagoon appears only at the end of a Peso Green gradient.
Don't add drop shadows to panels, KPI tiles, rows, or groups that sit in the page.
Don't hard-code hex colors outside the category palette and logo gradient.
Don't use `alert` or `confirm`, or add a chart library. Dialogs are `<Modal>`, and charts are hand-built SVG.
Don't show status by color alone.
